title: In repos/development-vessel/src/resolvers/substrate-gap.ts, the function gapFromFlatPointer builds its returned gap obje
description:
In repos/development-vessel/src/resolvers/substrate-gap.ts, the function gapFromFlatPointer builds its returned gap object from only these fields: id, category, source, status, detected_at, summary, and an optional route. It silently discards classification_metadata, so any gap written through the flat-pointer path loses its measurement predicate (edit_site, expected_literal, hardcoded_url) and classifyFalsifier then stamps falsifier "none" because it receives an empty object.

Change: carry classification_metadata through in that returned object literal, exactly as the optional route field is already carried, when the incoming flat pointer supplies it as an object.

The anchor is this verbatim line inside gapFromFlatPointer:

    ...(str("route") ? { route: str("route") } : {}),

Add one sibling spread immediately after that line so the returned object also includes classification_metadata when the pointer carries an object under that key. Do not change any other function, and do not change the merge semantics at the update site.
